authoring_contract.ordinary_stock: Each locality needs ordinary housing, contemporary infill and commercial/industrial stock; heritage examples never set their frequency.
authoring_contract.selection: Choose locality, settlement type, use and evidenced era before a style variant; never infer ethnicity, religion or a historic style from coordinates.
authoring_contract.geometry: Do not invent footprints, courtyards, storeys, roof forms, stilt heights, sacred features or monuments from a regional label.
authoring_contract.materials: Palette weights are candidate artistic ratios. Render is not an implemented earth material; metal/tile do not implement thatch.
authoring_contract.activation: All 64 themes use a bundled offline polygon map and bounded regional grammar. Further local variants require reference review, geometry checks and game playtesting.
authoring_contract.coverage: Global country/map-unit coverage with province/locality overrides and 500 m unambiguous shoreline tolerance; administrative and authored transitions approximate architectural geography.
